claims.statement: For three orthonormal eigenvectors R with |lambda_j|>=L and mu=max_i ||R_i||^2, sqrt(E0)+sqrt(3 mu (E1+E2+E3)) >= L^3 for the actual full-matrix third-compound overlap energies.
If mu<=1/48 then one B07 finite original-coordinate overlap packet has squared determinant mass at least 4 L^6/9375.
For an original-coordinate cross block B with Delta3=e3(BB^T)>0 and one-side range leverage <=q/2 for 1<=q<3/2, Q has a continuous C0 density with the explicit Beta-function bound in REPORT.md.
If mu<=1/48, the Pluecker ledger lands in q=0, and the resulting cross block has one-side range leverage <=1/2, then ||p_Q||_infinity <21/L and the density is continuous.
